[element-comm-ref]
=== `<comm-ref>` Committee Reference

Identifies the Technical Committee, Subcommittee, and optionally Working Group responsible for the standard, or example, “`ISO/TC 27/SC 4`”.

#### Usage/Remarks
To allow for a hierarchy of groups, a <<element-comm-ref-group,`<comm-ref-group>`>> element has been created to hold multiple <<element-comm-ref,`<comm-ref>`>> elements or nested <<element-comm-ref-group,`<comm-ref-group>`>>s.

#### Attributes

#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>

#### May be contained in

<<element-comm-ref-group,`<comm-ref-group>`>>, <<element-iso-meta,`<iso-meta>`>>, <<element-nat-meta,`<nat-meta>`>>, <<element-reg-meta,`<reg-meta>`>>, <<element-std-doc-meta,`<std-doc-meta>`>>, <<element-std-meta,`<std-meta>`>>

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more

....
...
<nat-meta originator="NEN">
 ...
 <comm-ref>Normcommissie 342 092 "Niet-destructief onderzoek"</comm-ref>
 <secretariat>NEN</secretariat>
 <ics>25.160.40</ics>
 <std-xref type="revises">
  <std-ref type="dated">NEN-EN 970:1998</std-ref>
 </std-xref>

</nat-meta>
...

#### Hierarchy of committees

[source,xml]
....
...
<std-meta>
 ...
 <comm-ref-group level="1">
  <comm-ref>Committee on Power Boilers (BPVC I)</comm-ref>
  <comm-ref-group level="2">
   <comm-ref>Subgroup on Design (BPVC I)</comm-ref> 
   <comm-ref>Subgroup Locomotive Boilers (BPVC I)</comm-ref> 
   <comm-ref>Subgroup on Materials (BPVC I)</comm-ref>   
  </comm-ref-group>
 </comm-ref-group>
 ...
</std-meta>
...
....
